_readme: User-visible changes in the replacement app, newest first.

entries.summary: Home tabs on phones keep their icons.
detail: Each phone tab shows its icon and name on the top line, the level or waiting count beneath.

entries.summary: Home: Learn and Practise are now two tabs, one open at a time, on desktop and phone.
detail: Each tab shows one fact: Learn its level, Practise how many words are waiting (red dot when there are mistakes).
Home opens on Practise when words are waiting, otherwise Learn; your own choice holds for the visit.
The open section keeps its ? in the top-right corner; the title moved into the tab. The phone fold rows are gone.
Before anything is in Practise there are no tabs, just Learn.

entries.summary: Desktop sidebar: “Add to iPhone” button opens a four-step guide.
detail: Replaces the small install card: a sidebar button under Account opens a popup with four mock iPhone screens (Share, View More, Add to Home Screen, Add).
Highlights use the language colour; the popup closes with ✕, a click outside, or Escape.

entries.summary: Sense head no longer overlaps its translation; expression rows cleaned up; conjugation drill opens full screen and returns to the card.
detail: A word type's shared translation (e.g. será: "will be") drops to its own row when it would collide with "verb from ser" or the meter.
Expressions no longer show a gold star on every row, and the Example pill drops its stray quotation marks.
"All tenses in conjugation mode" from a card closes the card's panel, opens the drill full screen, and Back/✕ return to the card.

entries.summary: Learn and Practise: larger buttons with a soft glow.
detail: Both buttons are taller (58px, 64px on desktop) with bolder, larger labels and a soft glow in the language colour, so they read as the two things to press. Neither leads.

entries.summary: Learn and Practise buttons brighter, with a raised edge.
detail: Fill is now 80% of the language accent (was 62%), white text contrast about 4.8:1 on green and 6.8:1 on red.
A faint top highlight and soft shadow make them read as pressable. Smart Skip is unchanged.

entries.summary: Desktop: no more Learn box jump on level change; lighter Learn, Practise and Smart Skip fills; “…of speech”.
detail: Changing level no longer hides Practise for a moment, which made the Learn box jump to full width and bounce back.
Learn and Practise buttons are lighter (62% accent, was 45%); Smart Skip is lighter too (36% accent on black, was near-black grey), still the darker of the three.
Level line now reads “Complete Level N to recognise X% of speech” (no “everyday”).
Install tip shrinks to its title and mock toolbar on short windows, and hides if it would still be cut off.

entries.summary: Desktop sidebar: “Add to iPhone” install tip.
detail: A small card at the bottom of the sidebar shows mock iPhone Safari icons (Share, Add to Home Screen) and “In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.”
The ✕ hides it on that device.

entries.summary: Phone home: centred folded row, no dot on unstarted levels, squeezes onto short screens.
detail: The section you are not in (Learn or Practise) is now centred on phones.
A level tile shows a dot only once you have answered a card in that level; unstarted levels have none.
On phones under 740px tall (a browser tab with its URL bar showing) the home screen drops the example-words line and tightens spacing so Learn, Practise and the buttons fit without scrolling.

entries.summary: Settings: round close button, centred tabs with a pill highlight.
detail: The close X is a true circle again (it had been squashed to 40×44).
Study / App / Your words are centred, and the selected tab has a soft pill around the whole word instead of an underline.

entries.summary: Settings scale with the window; level line reads “Complete Level N to recognise X% of everyday speech”.
detail: Laptop Settings type, icons, close button and column now grow with the window width, so they fill a large screen.
Level picker coverage line: “Complete Level N to recognise X% of everyday speech” (was “By Level N, you’ll recognise …”).

entries.summary: Settings on laptop: bigger type and a wider column.
detail: From 900px up: 38px title, 20px tabs, 22px row labels, 17px descriptions and larger switches, in an 860px centred column.
Removed the doubled rules under the title and tabs. Phone sizes are unchanged.

entries.summary: Settings on desktop: one centred column.
detail: Title, tabs, rows and the close button now share one centred 720px column instead of a narrow strip beside a full-width title bar.
Removed the thin vertical lines around the selected tab.

entries.summary: Clarify that level coverage follows completing the level.
detail: The level picker now says “Complete Level 4 to recognise X% of everyday speech”, with the selected level and coverage filled in.

entries.summary: Settings on desktop: one surface, aligned rows.
detail: The Settings title bar now matches the page instead of sitting on a darker panel.
Theme, Text size and Account rows share the same inset as the rest of the rows.

entries.summary: Settings rows no longer stretch across a wide screen.
detail: On desktop the flat Settings rows are capped at 560px and line up under the title, so each label sits next to its switch.

entries.summary: Centre Browse all and Mistakes first in Practise.
detail: Browse all is centred across the Practise content area, including the empty state.
The Mistakes first note is centred above the Practise button.

entries.summary: Settings rows no longer stretch across a wide screen.
detail: On desktop the flat Settings rows are capped at 560px and line up under the title, so each label sits next to its switch.

entries.summary: White coverage and example text on the level picker.
detail: Coverage, percentage digits and example words are white in dark mode, with neutral dark text in light mode.
Darker green Learn and Practise buttons remain unchanged.

entries.summary: Larger level arrows, a slimmer desktop sidebar and roomier study panels.
detail: Level arrow targets increase to 64px on mobile and 72px on desktop.
The desktop sidebar is 10% narrower; Practise receives all 23.6px of recovered width while Learn keeps its previous width.
Desktop Learn and Practise panel gutters and inner control padding are reduced by 20%.

entries.summary: Flatter Settings, and Saved words now open in their own popup.
detail: Settings tabs are one flat surface: underlined tabs, plain-text switches and hairline rows instead of boxes inside boxes.
Saved is a single row in Settings → Your words (hidden until you save something) that opens a Saved popup; the list no longer sits inside Settings.
Progress's Saved button opens the same popup.
Languages-you-know flags are bigger.

entries.summary: Brighter language-tinted level details and darker Learn and Practise buttons.
detail: Coverage, percentage digits and every example word use a pale language colour in dark mode, with a darker equivalent in light mode.
Learn and Practise use a darker language-coloured fill to keep white button text readable.

entries.summary: Clearer level picker, tidier Smart Skip controls and focused meaning pinning.
detail: Coverage now reads “By Level 4, you’ll recognise X% of everyday speech”, above brighter example words.
Larger level arrows and desktop progress legend; white Learn and Practise button text.
Smart Skip master switch and count move to the desktop left; mobile hides the total.
Meaning pinning hides scrubbers and other tools, keeps See again visible, and places instructions on the card with extra room for pins.

entries.summary: Merged cards: singular and plural nouns (casa/casas) and gender forms (querido/querida) now share a card.
detail: Noun proof noun-merge/v3: a feminine form counts as an inflection like a plural; another word on a noun's menu (casa: casar) no longer blocks it, and is judged by the 3-example, 10% bar instead; a noun and adjective of one headword are one word.
Portuguese: 1,073 forms join 813 cards (casa/casas, coisa/coisas, vida/vidas, querido/querida/queridos, conta/contas).
Spanish: six feminine forms join (profesora, compañera, secretaria…); most Spanish nouns still lack SpanishDict evidence.
Full list: docs/audits/noun-merge-v3-2026-10-26/README.md.

entries.summary: Merged cards: a noun spelled like its verb (o olhar "gaze", o poder "power") now gets its own card.
detail: Rule form-privilege/v3 (decision 0033): a noun with the same headword as its verb's infinitive counts as another word, on the infinitive's spelling or its plural only.
Portuguese: olhar, olhares, poder and andar get their own cards; their other forms (olha, pode, anda…) stay merged. Spanish: no change.
Conjugated forms are never split by it: Spanish sean, where the name Sean had been filed under ser "being", stays on ser.

entries.summary: Deploy fix: the production build no longer hangs while reading the app's files.
detail: The site builder wrote every file id to git before reading any back; past ~4,000 files both pipes filled and the Linux deploy hung for an hour.
It now feeds the ids from a separate thread. No change to the app itself.

entries.summary: Merged word cards now show sentences from all their forms, taken in turn, instead of mostly their commonest form.
detail: Each study set loaded only its own 25 cards' sentences, so a merged card like ser showed 30 of its 808 sentences, all with "é".
New per-set pool files (lemma-pool/v1, Portuguese and Spanish) carry a sample of every other form's sentences: up to 30 per meaning, a form at a time.
Cards cycle through the forms (foi, é, era, …); lines with an English translation still come first.
Level 1 Portuguese: ser now has 195 sentences from 28 forms, estar 265 from 34.

entries.summary: Fix: the level picker no longer shows "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'url')" after a fresh load.
detail: A level render could run during start-up before a language was chosen; it failed and its Try again kept the missing language.
The picker now uses the chosen language and waits when none is chosen yet.

entries.summary: Rank teaching examples by offline LaBSE scores, including the updated Portuguese release.
detail: Replace the length/number heuristic with existing cached translation-pair scores. Selected examples carry score, model and version in their metadata; higher scores appear first.
Bind the score companion to the newly updated Portuguese DECIDE-1 expressions release: all 139,957 selected examples have cached scores. Spanish coverage remains 282,808 of 282,808.
Load only the relevant set’s score files. Selection and frequencies are untouched by the alignment change; ties keep the existing ordering and unscored examples stay available.
Local mobile verification: Portuguese assim opens at 0.964 and Spanish esa at 0.977; cycling keeps the example pool intact. All 436 app tests and 88 release tests passed.

entries.summary: Use existing offline LaBSE alignment scores to show clearer teaching examples first.
detail: Carry the cached sentence-pair score, model and version into example metadata; future releases retain it through compact shards.
Spanish and Portuguese current releases receive release-bound companions: 282,808 Spanish and 139,859 Portuguese selected examples, all scored. Only the active set’s score files load.
Higher-scored Speech examples appear first. Ties retain the existing ordering; unscored examples remain available. The temporary length/number heuristic is removed.
Selection, frequency, progress identity and published deck assets stay unchanged. Verified on local mobile cards: assim 0.964 and esa 0.977, with example cycling intact.
